idea-plugin.name: Iconify Icon Preview
idea-plugin.description:
See Iconify icons right in the editor. Every quoted icon name such as "mdi:home" or "material-symbols:settings" gets the icon drawn next to it, so you know what <Icon icon="emojione-monotone:atm-sign" /> looks like without leaving the code.

  • Inline preview in the editor's text color, sized to the line, in any file type (JSX, TSX, Vue, HTML, CSS, JSON…).
  • Hover an icon for a large preview and its full name.
  • Click an icon to open its page on iconify.design.
  • Works with all 200+ Iconify icon sets. Only names of real sets are previewed, so strings like "12:30" are left alone.
  • Each icon is downloaded once and cached on disk; previews keep working offline.
  • Private: no telemetry. Only icon names are sent to the Iconify API, never your code. See the privacy policy.

Settings → Tools → Iconify Icon Preview: turn previews off or use your own Iconify API server.

Not affiliated with Iconify.
